scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -k -n libs,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:libs" "npm run dev -w @ziro/api" "npm run dev -w @ziro/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @ziro/api && npm run build -w @ziro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.datagen: npm run build:libs && npm run datagen -w @ziro/datagen --
scripts.db:generate: npm run build:libs && npm run db:generate -w @ziro/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:libs && npm run db:migrate -w @ziro/api
